evals.prompt: I have a listing appointment Thursday for 517 Hickorywood Ave in Altamonte Springs. My notes from the seller call and my Stellar CMA export are attached. Can you build the seller report and the listing presentation?
evals.expected_output: Reads both files; asks only for what's missing (roof permit, AC/pool equipment ages, payoff, brokerage terms) without blocking; runs stats.py with the subject excluded; 3-6 Spring Oaks pool comps including ones that argue lower; range about $455-480K and a recommended price inside it (e.g. $469,900); three strategies grounded in the recent sale-to-list and concession data; brokerage shown as a 2.5% + 2.5% placeholder and title fees as the built-in $1,145 estimate, both named in the reply; compute.py warnings resolved; render.py --format all produces the PDF (page 1 fits), the 15-slide PPTX and the .cma.json handoff; slides checked for overflow; short chat reply listing the placeholders to replace

evals.prompt: Quick one, just tell me in chat, no PDF: what should we list 517 Hickorywood at, and what would my sellers walk away with? Commission is 2.75% listing and 2.25% to the buyer's agent, and their payoff is about $210,000. Export attached.
evals.expected_output: Markdown mode from seller-cma-template.md: recommended price, range, expected sale, the three options with estimated cash at closing after the $210,000 payoff (brokerage 2.75% + 2.25%, not labeled placeholder), buyer payment per option and the per-$10,000 effect, ending with the cma-handoff v1 block (side seller, recommended_list_price); every number from compute.py

evals.prompt: Can you do a listing CMA and presentation for my seller in Austin? Notes and the comps I pulled are attached.
evals.expected_output: Uses Texas, not Florida: no documentary stamp tax, Florida title rates, Florida title fees or 2.5% + 2.5% defaults; asks for the commission terms, title/closing costs (or a market profile) and the tax rate, or builds a report clearly marked Preliminary with the missing costs named; since there's no MLS export, works from the typed comps (no scatter slide) and says so; payoff turns the net into cash at closing
